subject: dsa
title: Missing Number
summary: The array should hold every value from 0 to n. Compare the full expected sum, 0 + 1 + ... + n, with the actual sum of the array; the difference is the one value left out.
problem: An array contains n distinct numbers drawn from the range 0 to n. Find the single number in that range that is missing.

steps.caption: This array holds n = 3 numbers, so it should contain every value from 0 to 3. Exactly one of them is missing.
Numbers 0 through 3 should each appear once. Their full sum is 0 + 1 + 2 + 3 = 6.
Now sum the array we actually have: 3 + 0 + 1 = 4.
Whatever is missing accounts for the entire gap between the two sums.
